metadata.description: Skillgate: a ready-made way of working for AI-assisted development. Base plugins: context-hygiene, workflow, guardrails.

plugins.name: context-hygiene
plugins.description: Bounded session-start checklist hook and a context-hygiene skill. A separate, reversible setup script adds a status line that logs real quota. The gate wrapper and drift check exist in the repo but are not wired into the plugin yet.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: dispatch turns notes into verified parallel lanes; maintain keeps living docs, decisions, and lessons current; handoff writes a resume note that the next session is shown at start; review explains uncommitted changes in plain English with a commit verdict.
